data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a mixed prior year development in 2014. There was a gross release of GBP 45.795 million for the 2012 and prior years of account, while the 2013 year of account saw a gross strengthening of GBP 4.818 million. Overall, this resulted in a net gross release of GBP 40.977 million. The development was generally attributed to favourable claims experience and robust reserves.
raw_causal_phrases: benefited from lower than average claims experience in the current year, as well as significant reserve releases from prior accident years.
favourable outcomes on the settlement of prior year claims, and a healthy release on prior year reserves.
The reserves set at 31 December 2013 have again proved to be robust, and we have been encouraged by improvements on prior year claims where a release overall has been possible.
significant contribution from the 2012 & prior years of account, which have benefited from reserve releases in the year.

The 2013 year of account was not significantly affected by catastrophe losses in 2014, and there have been no large losses reported on the Aviation account. Overall, the loss experience has been very good.
The reserves established at last year end in respect of 2012 and prior years have developed favourably during 2014.
